subject: Exec sign-off needed: Constellation Health - Custom ETL scope & onboarding concession
messages:
From: Marta Suarez <marta.suarez@constellationhealth.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal - onboarding + ETL connectors

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Constellation is very keen to move forward but we need the following to be included in the commercial:

- Concierge-grade onboarding (centralized PM + weekly checkpoints) included year 1
- Delivery of three custom ETL connectors (legacy EMR, claims feed, and a nightly aggregate push) — customer expects these to be developed and handed over in the SOW scope.
- First-year support: Premium SLA (4 hour P1, dedicated success contact) included at no extra charge.

Our procurement team needs an updated SOW and confirmation of any discounts on onboarding fees. I attached the revised SOW our legal redlined (see attachment). Can you loop your execs for any concessions?

Thanks,
Marta Suarez
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Constellation Health
[Attachment: Constellation_SOW_v2.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:06:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Redwood proposal - onboarding + ETL connectors — need exec approval

Team,

FYI — Constellation (HS-23819) wants Concierge-grade onboarding + three custom ETL connectors and Premium support included year 1. They also asked about a discount on onboarding fees. I reviewed the redlines; major asks are: unlimited acceptance window for connectors, no explicit cap on dev hours in SOW, and the Premium SLA included for free.

I propose the following negotiable concession that still protects Redwood economics:
- 35% credit on onboarding fees (applied first invoice)
- Include Premium Support for year 1
- Include dev for up to 100 total hours for custom ETL work in the SOW; anything above is T&M at our standard CS rates.

Please review cost impact (Laura) and implementation risk (Priyom). Jonas/Vivek — need exec sign-off on the concession above; this deviates from standard onboarding pricing and scope caps.

Attachments: their redlined SOW.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: RE: FW: Redwood proposal - onboarding + ETL connectors — need exec approval

Rishi / team,

Reviewed the numbers and modeled a few scenarios (see attached cost model). Key points:
- 35% onboarding credit reduces immediate gross by ~36k on a $103k onboarding line; however we recover via committed usage (they're projecting 5M tokens/mo).
- Including Premium Support for year 1 increases our support cost delta by an estimated $28k (additional 0.3 FTE weighted hours + priority routing).
- Allowing 100 hours dev in SOW is doable but we need to lock acceptance criteria in the SOW to avoid scope creep. I recommend:
  - Explicit acceptance tests for each connector; 2 sprints per connector max in the SOW.
  - Timeboxed integrated validation window (30 days) before additional work is considered change order.

If leadership approves the 35% credit + Premium Support, we should attach an amendment document spelling the caps and acceptance criteria. I created a draft amendment (Redwood_Onboarding_Terms_Amendment.docx).

--Laura
Sales Operations Manager
[Attachment: Cost_Model_Constellation.xlsx]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: FW: Redwood proposal - onboarding + ETL connectors — need exec approval

Quick feasibility readout:

- Implementation team is available but Q3 calendar is tight. We can commit to 100 hours for custom connector dev in the first 90 days if the SOW includes prioritized acceptance criteria and a single POA.
- Risk: connector work touches on onboarding data-store access patterns; we need earlier access to their staging environment to hit timelines. If access is delayed, we'll need to shift to a change-order model.
- Support: Premium SLA (4-hour P1) will require a nominal increase in on-call coverage; we can provide this for year 1 with the caveat we reserve the right to re-evaluate capacity if usage materially exceeds forecasts.

Action items for SOW: environment access checklist, auth/account provisioning timeline, and explicit rollback/acceptance steps per connector.

—Priyom
Director, Customer Success

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: FW: Redwood proposal - onboarding + ETL connectors — need exec approval

Rishi / team,

Approved with conditions. I sign off on: 35% onboarding credit, Premium Support included for year 1, and up to 100 hours of custom ETL development included in the SOW. Conditions:
1) All connectors must have explicit acceptance tests and delivery milestones in the SOW.
2) Overage billed T&M at standard CS rates; require PO for additional work.
3) Add clause: Redwood reserves the right to re-evaluate support SLA and pricing if monthly token usage exceeds 8M tokens for two consecutive months.
4) Legal must include an amendment referencing the cost recovery schedule (Laura to finalize).

Once the amendment is attached to the SOW and Constellation signs, proceed with onboarding kickoff. Laura — please send the finalized amendment to me for sign-off before external send.

—Vivek
SVP, Sales

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marta Suarez <marta.suarez@constellationhealth.com>, procurement@constellationhealth.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal - onboarding + ETL connectors

Marta — thanks for the patience. Executive sign-off has been obtained with the following commercial terms (redlines enclosed):

- 35% credit applied to the onboarding invoice (applies to initial onboarding line only).
- Premium Support (4-hr P1 SLA, named customer success contact) included for year 1.
- Up to 100 hours of custom ETL development included in the SOW; each connector will have defined acceptance tests and delivery milestones.
- Any development hours beyond 100 are billed T&M at our standard rates and require a PO.
- Redwood reserves the right to revisit SLA/pricing if usage exceeds 8M tokens/mo for two consecutive months.

Next steps: Laura will share a short amendment to the SOW (Redwood_Onboarding_Terms_Amendment.docx) that enumerates the acceptance criteria and caps. If that looks good, please return a countersigned SOW and PO and we will schedule kickoff within 10 business days of receipt of PO + environment access.

Appreciate you moving quickly on this — excited to get started.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Terms_Amendment.docx]
